title: M4 Photography
outcome: A studio brand and a site that takes the orders
summary: A rebrand and website for Glyn Davies' Christchurch studio, which photographs schools, sports clubs and businesses. The brand now matches the quality of the work, and the site sends parents and clubs straight to ordering.

stats.label: Online order paths, school and sport

sections.head: A busy studio without a brand
sections.body: M4 shoots schools, sports clubs and businesses across Christchurch: high volume, tight turnarounds and a lot of people to organise on the day. There was no consistent visual identity and no website that explained the services or made it easy for parents and clubs to order photos.

sections.head: Build something that does the selling
sections.body: A brand a school administrator or club coordinator lands on and immediately trusts, a site that sets out each service clearly, and ordering that takes parents from the page to their photos without a phone call.

sections.head: A proper studio presence
sections.body: The site leads with the promise the business is built on, on time every time, and gives sport, school and business photography a page section each, with what's included set out plainly: travel to the club, naming on the night, EFTPOS on the day, and an online ordering portal for schools. School and sport orders each have their own path, and the site has been delivered.
